The shop was one of the several main ways to obtain items. The Item shop was not designed to obtain many items, but rather a way to obtain items that are commonly used.

The shop had five main categories that it separated into; end, nether, gear, food, and the shard shop. 

Shop was removed on June 2nd, 2026 as apart of [[June 2nd update|a larger update]].
